notes.title: Patch Notes 2.0.58940 (Spoilers)
notes.content:
New Features & Gameplay Adjustments



Reworked all the camping spots in Throes of the Watchmaker to increase variety.

Updated the train and mini rail buggy so they can now be controlled by all players during co-op play.

Adjusted the timing on multiple combat skills.

Tweaked the block timing for Narcis King's “Ganonball” attack to improve counterplay.

Made overall combat balancing adjustments in the DLC.

Optimized game performance.

Added the ability to generate a DLC-ready save from a New Game + save.

DLC bosses now count for the “What a Technique!” achievement.

Made select DLC trinkets available in the base game.

Revised several cutscene dialogues in the base game for improved narrative flow.

Added highlights on enemy locks when a target is selected, now active in both the DLC and the base game.



Bug Fixes



Fixed an issue where the Dweller of Scourge would switch heads when entering a cutscene.

Resolved a bug where Arty wouldn’t play rest animations when camping on the world map.

Fixed a visual issue where one of the mirrors in the Ivory Tower’s throne room appeared lowered on entry.

Corrected a bug causing Zale to face the wrong direction when using Entarte during an encounter in Wolf Rock.

Fixed an issue allowing player movement during a cutscene after solving a puzzle in Rail Forest.

Resolved a stacking audio bug in Big Top where the ticking timer sound would overlap when using the graplou repeatedly on the pullout block.

Added a missing sound effect when completing the fan & balloons puzzle in Horloge.

Fixed an issue that would cause a softlock when GBB tried to cast Pogpwn.

Corrected premature dialog triggers related to Keenathan not feeling well.

Fixed an issue where the yellow star marker remained on the map for Ivory Tower and Wolf Rock after completion.

Resolved a black screen issue that could occur when triggering a fight while exiting the combat challenge box in Horloge.

Fixed a bug where a ladder would fail to unroll during a puzzle sequence in Big Top.

Resolved a softlock caused by players getting stuck in the Jugglecore animation.

Fixed a softlock in Big Top triggered by using the drone simultaneously with the start of combat.

Addressed an issue where music sheets wouldn’t sell out in Horloge’s shop.

Fixed a progression-blocking bug where the clown face in Big Top would be lowered without ladders after reloading.

Corrected a bug in Wolf Rock where a block could be pushed out of bounds, blocking progress.

Fixed an issue where Sky Giants Island remained hidden on the map after being visited.

Resolved a potential crash when initiating combat while standing on a floor switch.

Fixed possible red sprite artifacts on the Artificer.

Addressed various other minor bugs and glitches across both the DLC and the base game.

notes.title: Sea of Stars: Throes of the Watchmaker Free DLC is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The time has come: Throes of the Watchmaker — the free DLC for Sea of Stars — is out now!

We spent nearly two incredible years crafting this free DLC as a heartfelt thank-you to our fans. Your support made it possible, and we hope this bonus final adventure for Sea of Stars will bring you joy.

To celebrate the launch, Sea of Stars is currently available at its lowest price since release, with a limited-time discount of 35% off!

[previewyoutube=tgFi2jXwzVI;full][/previewyoutube]

If you want to help in bringing more eyeballs to this circus-themed romp, the best way is always to leave a comment on the trailer on YouTube, and share [our posts] on social media.

How To Access The DLC?

1.  The DLC is not included as an automatic update. To get started, you’ll need to manually download it from Steam or your console’s storefront.

2. Throes of the Watchmaker is a post-game adventure, so you must open up a save file where you have rolled the end credits at least once to unlock access.

3. After meeting the requirement above, return to the world map in-game. You’ll receive a new prompt via a message-in-a-bottle: It’s a message from Hortence urging you to return to the Vespertine and check on Keenathan.

When prompted with: “Hortence sounds really worried. Should we visit the crew right now?” Choose Yes to continue.

4. You’ll be transported to the top deck of the Vespertine. Head below deck and speak with the pirate crew to officially begin the Throes of the Watchmaker side-adventure.

5. Malevolent spectacle awaits!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/925a6c0bd2fe681791721cfb060c8755627df235.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/6dfc51cf50a64b6f582a9724e1ccc7ed4726f5e8.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/3f99d3ff316145cd1214192fc52980d55244aaf9.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/a6d738435cb3dfc926171803e05b0ee7ea4d7d31.png

Italian Localization

Great news for our Italian friends! 

Italian localization is now available for both the Sea of Stars main adventure and the free DLC.

Alright, Time to Play Now!

This release marks the full realization of everything we set out to build — first with Dawn of Equinox, and now with this DLC. What a journey it’s been over the last few years! We’re incredibly grateful for your support at every step of the way. 

We hope that this farewell letter to our dream project will bring you joy, and that you will allow it to tell you one last time, from all of us: THANK YOU!

All the love,
-SaboTeam

notes.title: Throes of the Watchmaker is Coming May 20th + New Trailer!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The day is set: Throes of the Watchmaker — the free DLC for Sea of Stars — is coming to all platforms on May 20th, 2025!

The announcement was made this morning, accompanied by a whole new trailer showcasing the scope, narrative, and tone of this wacky post-game bonus adventure. We hope you're as excited as we are, because the playtest results are in and it clocks over 8 hours of completely new content!

The scope of this DLC went way beyond what we initially envisioned, which was only made possible through the warm and overwhelming response we have been blessed with.

[previewyoutube=tgFi2jXwzVI;full][/previewyoutube]

If you want to help  in bringing more eyeballs to this circus-themed romp, the best way is always to leave a comment on the video on YouTube, and share our posts on social media.

THROES OF THE WATCHMAKER DEV STREAM, TODAY AT 2PM ET!

The trailer is here, and the release date is set — it’s time to celebrate! Join us live later today as we showcase Throes of the Watchmaker. We’ll take you inside the miniature clockwork world of Horloge to explore the DLC’s unique mechanics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/0040b6dc6206026984c0f70992e584bb38b45cc4.png

Come on and join us at 2PM ET, it should be a lot of fun: twitch.tv/sabotagestudio


MALEVOLENT SPECTACLE AWAITS

Since it’s been a long time since our latest update on the DLC, here’s a recap of what you can expect from Throes of the Watchmaker.

Over 8 hours of completely new Areas, Music, Dungeons, Mini-Games, Enemies, Bosses, and Puzzles

Journey into a magical miniature clockwork world where a plethora of oddities and wonders await. The world of Horloge is filled with unique environments, NPCs, enemies and dungeons. This thing is packed, with Throes of the Watchmaker boasting the same budget for cinematics that the main game had, allowing us to richly realize key narrative moments and deliver this new tale with even more density and production value.

And of course, Sabotage’s composer Eric W. Brown returns alongside guest composer Yasunori Mitsuda to bring a completely fresh set of tracks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/789357db5511c76d2b8f7eab906d9605401e230b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/af9d786f53751119d84ddd6fc1262c8cbae03352.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/f37617e2024b9fbbcbd0fb1e877415f510f49605.png

New Playable Classes for Valere and Zale

The world of Horloge plays by different rules, and for their magic to manifest, the Solstice Warriors will need to adapt. Zale will tap into his agility to become a Juggler, while Valere will harness her balance to dazzle as an Acrobat. Playing to the circus-themed curse, they will unlock a completely new set of attacks, damage types, skills and combos.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/ae04cc1afe3aa5a9b08a8607981e3b15ce6cbdcc.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/a70d882fc064c81ff370c31659a60320c2b2ab76.png

New Playable Character: Arty

Artificer joins the party! The friendly engineer robot will finally unlock the laser-shooting capabilities of his construct, and join Valere and Zale in the fight to save Horloge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/eea80f22ab179a0d2d84b5705393c0152f573db9.png

Couch Co-Op With Up To 3 Players

The couch co-op mode that was added to Sea of Stars via the Dawn of Equinox update in November 2024 is also available for Throes of the Watchmaker. It allows up to three players to engage in traversal and combat with a “Co-Op timed hits” mechanic!

THAT’S IT FOR NOW

We’d love for you to join us for the Throes of the Watchmaker DLC dev stream later today! If you can’t make it, no worries — the VOD will be available tomorrow, and we’ll see you on May 20th when the DLC launches for free, everywhere.

We hope that this farewell letter to our dream project will bring you joy, and that you will allow it to tell you one last time, from all of us: THANK YOU!

All the love,
-SaboTeam

notes.title: The Dawn of Equinox Update is Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The Dawn of Equinox update is available to download for free on all platforms, right now!

Here’s the new trailer, showcasing some of the main changes coming with the update:

[previewyoutube=pk6FYIift0Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We ultimately see Dawn of Equinox as the community’s gift to us - the overwhelming support you’ve all shown us ever since we first announced Sea of Stars helped give our team the chance to return to the project, and present a refined version of it including everything we ever hoped this adventure to be.

There's even more in store in the upcoming DLC Throes of the Watchmaker, but in the meantime, we couldn’t be happier with how Sea of Stars feels with this major update.

DAWN OF EQUINOX UPDATE OVERVIEW

In case you missed it, the key changes were presented comprehensively during a livestream a few weeks ago.

3 Player Couch Co-op

Sea of Stars’ adventure is now playable in its entirety by up to three players, with allies traversing the world together and mastering a new Co-op Timed Hits combat mechanic. Yes, what was initially presented as a more limited “Single Player +” mode has evolved into a full-fledged co-op experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/4a320147836eac1c83a1c22f85b5ef7ac1cd8485.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/f0f63a72d8c74a6d5fcc6272e1366477523d2a43.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/7a836d6af59acc2d08d7c5edab06a93063a4e8d7.png

Combat 2.0

The addition of Mystery Locks brings a new gameplay loop around revealing the ways to break the spells of new enemies entering the fray. Along with "Reveal" functions added to some of the special skills, Combo Points now remain after battle, offering new ways to open certain encounters, or test different damage types on enemies to reveal their locks. 

A comprehensive balancing pass has also been done to reflect both these new changes and player feedback since launch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/6234c5decad3c300d7105e087b2267bc8fc504b6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/127a0baaa284716c11bbe25c34605cb884bec91a.png

A revamped prologue

Implementing combat for the young versions of our heroes, the updated flow does away with the flashback structure to begin in their childhood directly including action in the prologue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/c8caf743e97cb06e7b3efded71d75581bbac1b2d.png

Bonus Cinematic Scene

An entirely new cutscene has been added to accentuate a pivotal moment in the original adventure, referred to as "Paths on Water".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/c91cbd8a2e266dfcc0fddce488188f073196d18e.png

Speedrunner Mode Relic

This new Relic was designed with the help of the speedrunning community, activating a range of features helpful for those looking to set a new personal best or world record.

Difficulty Presets

Three difficulty settings are now available when starting a new game, which are presets using the game's Relics. New Relics have also been added, some for quality of life, and others for difficulty adjustments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/a3336be64774dcce23dd2601de363027ac172b06.png

Improved Parrot Relic

The secret-tracking parrot has learned a few new tricks to better assist players tracking down overlooked challenges and collectibles.

Québécois Localization

The long-awaited, comprehensive French Canadian translation for our Québec folks is now available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/6b2f88a138eccb32dc7a3164d5c934ffeb139a70.png

A number of other general updates, bug fixes and QoL improvements spanning Sea of Stars’ full campaign are also part of the Dawn of Equinox update.

THAT’S IT FOR NOW

We’re grateful for all the love and support the game has received over the past year, which made it possible for us to fully realize our vision. We hope this will give fans of the game plenty of reasons to revisit it while waiting for the upcoming DLC Throes of the Watchmaker, coming Spring 2025.

All the love,

-SaboTeam

notes.title: 2023 RPG standout Sea of Stars details free update coming real soon
notes.content:
You really need to play Sea of Stars. What Yacht Club Games did to revitalize 8-bit platformers with Shovel Knight, Sabotage Studio did for retro-style RPGs with its 2023 hit. Taking cues from genre greats like Earthbound, old-school Final Fantasy, and Chrono Trigger, it's a sublime turn-based adventure. It's so good in fact, that it's turned more people than I can name around on the genre of turn-based RPGs. So if you're yet to play it or want to drag an unassuming friend along for the ride, the newly revealed Sea of Stars Dawn of Equinox update will be the perfect time.

notes.title: Sea of Stars DLC is Coming for Free Spring 2025!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’re almost exactly one year away from the release of Sea of Stars (!!!), and while we've been a bit quiet lately, we’re excited to share some fantastic news today.

Throes of the Watchmaker is coming Spring 2025, for free!

[previewyoutube=yBnJv-rQjMM;full][/previewyoutube]

Visit the DLC’s website for everything there is to know so far. We hope you’re as excited as we are about this new adventure!

Malevolent Spectacle Awaits

Throes of the Watchmaker finds the Solstice Warriors Valere and Zale venturing into the miniature clockwork world of Horloge. In this magical land where denizens are threatened by a cursed carnival, our heroes will need to adapt to unfamiliar rules if their Sun and Moon powers are to manifest.

New playable classes for Valere and Zale

To fight against the minions of The Puppeteer, Zale will tap into his agility to become a Juggler, while Valere will harness her balance to dazzle as an Acrobat. Playing to the circus-themed curse, they will unlock a completely new set of equipment, attacks, damage types, skills and combos.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/bf9d313b53a1354ff6874045571386080857604c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/9dd80521cfe3b9bb18a6fae585816be4da718c63.png

New playable character: Arty!

Artificer joins the party! The friendly engineer robot will finally unlock the laser-shooting capabilities of his construct, and join Valere and Zale in the fight to save Horloge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/bee6333d42eb9feaf042012dcb4ca035e05fd8e0.png

Completely new areas, music, dungeons, enemies, bosses and puzzles

Journey into a magical miniature clockwork world where a plethora of oddities and wonders await. The world of Horloge, where a cursed carnival threatens the innocent denizens, is filled with unique environments, NPCs, enemies and dungeons. And of course, Sabotage’s composer Eric W. Brown and special collaborator Yasunori Mitsuda return to bring a completely fresh set of tracks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/660f3cfe244e4832451835d07c44061f116b4566.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/5cc323c049a1b813061ac3e1c50783e858d88701.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/4460bbf1d559775abd7bf3407f59d7df8f0e5ff7.png

Local Co-op with up to 3 players

Throes of the Watchmaker will follow Sea of Stars’ local co-op update, which will allow three players to journey through Sea of Stars’ main adventure together. When it comes out, the entirety of the DLC will also be playable in three person co-op.

One year later, we're still overwhelmed by the continued love and enthusiasm for this world we created, and we can't wait for you to spend a few more hours discovering these new areas.

We’ll be back soon with updates for the rest of 2024.

-SaboTeam

notes.title: Sea of Stars: The Concept Art of Bryce Kho Is Now Available for Pre-Orders
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As you may know, the team is fully focused on production of the DLC at the moment, as well as the Couch Co-Op mode for Sea of Stars. While we’re very happy with the pace of development on both fronts, it’s still too early to reveal specific details for those yet. However, we do have a fun announcement for you all today.

The Sea of Stars physical art book is printing as we speak!

Sea of Stars: The Art of Bryce Kho is a 272-page collection of concept art from the game, featuring over 90+ illustrations of concepts for playable characters, NPCs, enemies, bosses, and environments. The book also showcases the creative process through excerpts of conversations between concept artist Bryce Kho and creative director Thierry Boulanger.

It’s published in partnership with 3dtotal, and we couldn’t have dreamed of a partner better aligned with the vision we had for it.  To say that we’re very happy with the final product would be an understatement. We hope you’ll love it too!

Pre-orders are now open over at 3dtotal.com, and include free shipping in the US and the UK! The official release is coming on May 28th.

SEA OF STARS: THE CONCEPT ART OF BRYCE KHO, PUBLISHED BY 3DTOTAL

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/1ad2547906471ffe22058cbc8cdd6dbe2030fe7a.jpg

3dtotal is a publisher dedicated to delivering high-quality publications that offer creative insight, expert advice, and essential motivation to artists and enthusiasts. The 3dtotal Publishing audience is very fond of character and concept digital art, making it an obvious partner for this beloved project of ours.

Sea of Stars: The Concept Art of Bryce Kho will have a high production value with hardback cover, foil finish on the front cover, and top quality paper.

It’s the ultimate resource to admire over 90 illustrations of concept art from all parts of the game. It’s also an intimate window into the many design discussions that took place between Thierry and Bryce during production.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/aaf39f012c97ad85db9c1e46601d3bc25ef0776c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/e4bc52103c6940e40650c0b054ae7be0e107bd55.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/d383d7aa084fe1246c6509ea46f6bff051517c29.jpg

Bryce Kho

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37125541/d83e1b40876ab52bace5ea990b15455ae5e1a346.jpg

“The iterations and conversations in this Art Book are a genuine look at Bryce and I’s process, and the daily conversations that brought the amazing cast of Sea of Stars to life. Looking back as I read through the final version of this book, it only reaffirmed one thing: this collaboration has been the stuff of dreams, and I couldn’t have picked a better artist.” - Thierry (Excerpt from the art book’s introduction)

In case you don’t know him already, Bryce Kho has been part of the Saboteam as lead concept artist since 2020. Known for his colorful and complex, retro-anime inspired illustrations, Bryce’s art style was a natural fit for the Sea of Stars universe. We look forward to continuing to work with him on our next project.

Find more of his work by visiting his Instagram profile or his online shop!

DIGITAL ART BOOK

The complete digital version of the art book will also be available to buy directly on Steam on May 28th. Stay tuned!

Cheers,

- Saboteam

notes.title: Official Launch Trailer
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Emotions are flying high at the studio with only one week left until we push the button to release Sea of Stars into the world. 

We're keeping ourselves busy until then, so let's look at the latest news!

THE LAUNCH TRAILER IS OUT!

We've been floating the idea of revealing a fourth playable character along with the launch trailer. In the end, we did go for it. There won't be any spoilers in this post, but if you prefer not to see the character reveal, we recommend avoiding the launch trailer for now!

[previewyoutube=8jkeh6O1Rzs;full][/previewyoutube]

The final week's ramp up to launch is by far the most critical moment for us, especially amidst all the high profile releases surrounding our launch window. So, now more than ever, if we can ask for your help one last time, the best way to bring eyeballs is to leave a comment on the video on YouTube, and share this tweet.

It wouldn't be possible to describe in words how we feel right now. In exactly seven days this dream project of ours will be sent out into the world for all to see. Putting the finishing touches over the past couple of months, there has been a unanimous sentiment on the team that we genuinely ended up with something we would consider special. 

So, thank you all once again for the overwhelming support and positivity throughout the years, we can't wait for all of you to finally get your hands on Sea of Stars. From our hearts to yours, we hope you are looking forward to a great adventure.

-SaboTeam

In case you are worried about spoilers, since the documentary was a Kickstarter stretch goal meant to release before launch we made sure not to show or discuss anything outside of what has been shown already in trailers and social media posts. Only two weeks left until you all get to explore the little world we built. As the press is busy playing the build and writing their reviews (embargo lifts August 28th, a day before launch), we join the wait while being thankful that it is now only a short one.

For those who might be wondering, it is the exact same demo that was released on Nintendo Switch back in February, including the minor updates that followed.

The demo will remain available on Steam after the Steam Next Fest.

notes.title: 2022 Wrap-Up + Road To Launch
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It’s been a while since our latest big announcement for Sea of Stars and it feels like an update is long overdue. For the past months we have been fully dialed in on concrete milestones to take this dream production home, and we're happy to report that both the team and the game are doing great!

While everyone's patience and support has been felt by all of us, we want you to rest assured that getting closer to launch also means slowly reemerging from the depths of gamedev to communicate more, starting of course with our community.

So, here’s a wrap-up of the highlights of 2022!

SEA OF STARS IS ON TRACK TO RELEASE IN 2023

While there is still a lot of work left, the path to launch is clearer than ever. The whole team is aligned and on pace to complete the production for Sea of Stars to release in 2023.

Working towards the infamous BETA milestone, technical unknowns are now behind us and all gameplay systems are locked-in. We are hard at work completing content, balancing and fine tuning the game's moment-to-moment experience.
 
While we cannot provide a specific release date yet, we want to reaffirm that 2023 will be the year Sea of Stars is released.

FROM TITLE SCREEN TO END CREDITS

Four years ago, a small team began work on the level design tools and renderer code that would be required to deliver the vision for Sea of Stars: unshackled traversal, dynamic lighting, and seamless turn-based combat.

As of writing this,  the game's main path is fully playable from title screen to end credits. Game mechanics sing the way we were hoping they would, and the story has been finalized with all levels fully playable.

In case you don’t follow us on social media, here’s a few updates you might have missed.

First, a look at the cooking menu.

[previewyoutube=b64OraUoNT4;full][/previewyoutube]

Here’s a quick stroll through Zenith Academy, with Valere and Zale as kids.

[previewyoutube=PKH-X-57O_w;full][/previewyoutube]

Oh, and here's a big boss just for fun!

[previewyoutube=FQBVGhHfkbQ;full][/previewyoutube]

SO, WHAT'S LEFT?

A bit of optional content, a lot of NPCs, localization, a whole lot of bug fixing, and an impossible amount of polishing. We are currently operating on a weekly build-review schedule, covering every segment of the game with the finest brush, ensuring readability of the levels, balanced combat, and properly paced cutscenes. 

To reach BETA, we need every and all moments and  elements of the game to be at the highest  quality we can produce.

THE LAST STRETCH

Once the game reaches BETA (content complete), we will work towards the last milestone, GOLD (bug-free), making sure Sea of Stars offers the best experience for everyone, on all its supported platforms. This implies performance optimization, accessibility, compliance, localization and quality assurance.

As a reminder, the game will be available in  English, French, German, Russian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, simplified Chinese and traditional Chinese.

LOOKING STRAIGHT AHEAD

As 2023 approaches, it is clear that we have a big year ahead of us. For now, it is time for the team to take some well-deserved time off, recharge and spend time with loved ones before we all get back together to finish this journey at last.

Again, your support, patience and optimism means a lot to the team. It carries us in these efforts, and after all this time has never failed to mean the world to us. We can’t wait for the moment you all finally play Sea of Stars!

Until then, thank you once again for everything, and we wish everyone a happy 2023!

With love,

-SaboTeam

notes.title: 2023 Release + PlayStation Announcement
notes.content:
As we are nearing an important production milestone, the road to launch materializes and we have important updates for you! Let's jump right in.

SEA OF STARS IS COMING TO PS4 AND PS5

It was always the plan to bring Sea of Stars to as many people as possible, but as with all things, planning and timing were key. Through PlayStation's Indie Spotlight event, we are happy to confirm today that Sea of Stars will be available on both PS4 and PS5 on launch day, cross-buy.

For over a year we have been working with PlayStation dev kits to make sure it ran as smoothly as on our other target platforms. To avoid spoilers, we showcased the same content as the Nintendo Switch trailer, but still made a point to recapture everything on PS4 and PS5 directly!

(If you want to help bring more eyeballs to Sea of Stars, please RT this post!)

[previewyoutube=yn7YkHsPiDE;full][/previewyoutube]

SEA OF STARS WILL RELEASE IN 2023

Emphasizing our two main priorities (quality of the finished game, and a healthy work-life balance for the team), production remains a road where the unexpected occurs a lot even if the destination is set. Where there is a wall we tear it down, where there is a tree we walk around it, and where there is a gem we pick it up. The vision remains clear, but seeing the response and hype we made the conscious decision to make sure to leave no gems on the floor. Something special is happening here, and we are committed to making the most of it.

We also want to make sure Sea of Stars is the best experience possible for everyone, which implies considerable efforts in terms of performance optimization, accessibility, localization, QA and porting.  

A precise release date will be announced as soon as we pass the Beta milestone.

Once again, thank you all for your overwhelming positivity and patience. 

NEXT STEPS

With virtually all technical risks  already tackled, the team is focused on finalizing the game's content. 

In closing, we want to once again thank you for your patience. It’s a long ride, and your overwhelming support goes a long way in keeping the team's motivation high. We feel truly blessed, and can’t wait for you to experience Sea of Stars in its final form.

With love,

-SaboTeam

notes.title: Production Update + Spring Q&A Stream
notes.content:
Q&A + WIZARD LAB DUNGEON PREVIEW ON TWITCH THIS FRIDAY MAY 13TH, AT 2PM EST / 11AM PST / 8PM CET

[previewyoutube=XilwGr_HAiM;full][/previewyoutube]

Back in February, around 20 minutes of new content from Sea of Stars was shown to a selected few media outlets. This preview included an updated look on many systems and a quest involving pirates, the port town of Brisk and mysterious arcane ruins known as the “Abandoned Wizard’s Lab”. 

Polish has gone a long way since our last stream, so we wanted to share this segment of Sea of Stars with our community. Make sure to tune in on Twitch this Friday May 13th, at 2PM EST / 11AM PST / 8PM CET! 

https://www.twitch.tv/sabotagestudio

The second half of the stream is reserved for Q&A. Join us if you are curious about the behind the scenes, or have a question of your own! We opened a #qna channel on Discord to drop your questions ahead of time.

Rest assured that this preview won’t reveal critical story beats or spoil anything other than lower-stakes events from the game. 

QUICK DEV UPDATE

In other news, here are a few spoiler-free dev updates you might have missed on social media. Most of these are low risk items we were saving for later in production. It's pretty exciting to be at a point where we are tackling these kinds of things! 

First, we’ve been asked many times over the last 2 years whether the full battle party would be seen running around outside of combat.

Yes, of course!

[previewyoutube=zKJ5mAwTCP0;full][/previewyoutube]

And here’s an updated look at sailing.

[previewyoutube=Y51Bv0017KU;full][/previewyoutube]

The combat hud also got a revamp! While not quite final, this new version offers more breathing space and readability.

[previewyoutube=oCFcLtiMEqw;full][/previewyoutube]

DEVELOPMENT IS GOING GREAT, BUT WE DON’T HAVE A RELEASE DATE YET


Production's velocity is at full throttle, with every part of the game gradually falling into place. While the road to a gold master has many more miles in store for us, it is quite thrilling to be at the front seat of Sea of Stars growing into its final form.

We're not ready to set a release date just yet, but the pace is good, and the team is committed to achieving the complete vision with no compromises. Remaining platforms and storefronts announcements will be coming soon, after which we will send the survey for the final phase of fulfillment (platform choices for physical and digital copies, civic address for shipping, name for the credits, etc.) 

Stay tuned! ​​And as always, we thank you for your patience and overwhelming support 

All the love,

- SaboTeam

notes.title: Hands-Off Press Preview Impressions
notes.content:
Last week we showed a new dungeon to journalists while answering their questions about Sea of Stars.

Many media outlets answered our call to attend the hands-off preview presented by Thierry, and we’re thrilled to finally share their impressions with the community.

It was truly humbling  to see them express in their own words what essentially boils down to what our vision has been all along. Nothing can feel more special for our team than  seeing such a reaction from fresh eyes looking at our game, especially as we buckle up for the final year of production. 

All the articles are linked in this Kickstarter update!

THE PRESS PREVIEW FEATURED A NEW DUNGEON: THE WIZARD LAB

Journalists were shown around 20 minutes of gameplay from a quest and a new dungeon involving pirates, the port town of Brisk and mysterious arcane ruins known as the "Abandoned Wizard's Lab" which included puzzles, illusions, enchanted enemies, and fishing.

Even though it didn't reveal critical story beats that would spoil later events in the game, we will be keeping most of the demo's content under wraps, as we know a lot of you would rather experience the game with as little knowledge as possible beforehand. Some of the articles do go in full detail about the preview though, so feel free to read or skip them at your convenience.

Otherwise, on a true spoiler-free note, it was revealed that Chrono Trigger composer Yasunori Mitsuda will contribute around 10 tracks to the game!

notes.title: New Trailer!
notes.content:
Hello Steam community,

We’ve been quiet here since the start of the project, but we plan on being more active going forward, starting with a pretty significant first update. 

We’re thrilled to finally reveal a new trailer!

[previewyoutube=b8BiyYO6loU;full][/previewyoutube]

It premiered during Indie World as we officially announced that Sea of Stars is coming to Nintendo Switch. If you’re interested in adding Sea of Stars to your Switch wishlist, the page is now up on the eShop.

We’ve already updated our Steam store page with the new trailer, new screenshots, and a few new visual assets, check it out!

(If you want to help bring more eyeballs to Sea of Stars, please RT this post!) 

THE TRAILER IS MEANT TO BE SPOILER FREE

As always, deciding where to draw the line in how much to show  is a challenge we take very seriously. If it was up to us, nothing would be shown to preserve the entirety of the experience. In reality, there has to be some give for people to be aware of the game, especially given the self-publishing indie studio need to build a community.

If you are mindful of spoilers, rest assured that only a small portion of the game was shown at this point, and that each shot was hand-picked to convey a mandatory portion of the promise without giving too much away.

HOLIDAY 2022 IS THE TARGET, BUT WE WON’T RUSH THE GAME.

To clear all the potential confusion that could arise from different interpretations of the Winter 2022 / Holiday 2022 messaging, let us say plainly that the target is to launch Sea of Stars roughly a year from now.

The exact date will be announced sometime next year once we have a clear view of when the game will be as good as we can make it. As always, the only thing we will not compromise on is quality.

2021 IS A WRAP

2021 was a big year of production for us, and we are happy to report that Sea of Stars is emerging as something that exceeds our expectations, mostly due to the overwhelmingly positive response and additional talent joining the team.

For 2022, production remains the top priority, but we will also be talking about the game a lot more as we get closer to release, with many more announcements and promotional activities already planned.
But for now, it is time for the team to rest. We want to thank you for the unbelievable support, and wish you all happy holidays. See you next year! 

Got questions for us? Drop us a line here, or feel free to join us on Discord!

-SaboTeam
